contentSection.heading: Our Product

items.description: Rose Gold Cabin blends warm elegance with modern luxury, adding a stylish and sophisticated touch to any building.

The Rose Gold Finish Cabin is a perfect fusion of elegance and warmth, designed to elevate the visual appeal of any modern building. With its unique rose gold stainless steel finish, this cabin delivers a premium and stylish statement, ideal for upscale residential apartments, boutique hotels, and luxurious office spaces. Every ride is transformed into a seamless experience of comfort and class.

contentSection.description: Crafted with high-quality rose gold stainless steel, this cabin features a stunning hairline or mirror finish enclosure that radiates charm and sophistication. It is fitted with a designer false ceiling and a built-in blower to ensure cool airflow and comfort.

items3.text: High-quality rose gold stainless steel with hairline or mirror finish
Designer false ceiling with built-in blower for comfort
Fully automatic centre-opening or telescopic doors
Matching rose gold finish on doors for a cohesive look

contentSection.description2: To complement the stunning visuals, the cabin is equipped with LED digital indicators at hall floors and plasma indicators inside the car, offering clear and modern readouts. Stylish SS90 square buttons and electronic door safety come as standard, ensuring both user-friendliness and passenger security.

items4.text: LED digital indicators at hall floors for clear display
Stylish SS90 square buttons for easy use
Electronic door safety for passenger security
Optional designer wall patterns and ambient lighting
